name: Poetry (Middle School)
prompts: Did the pacing give lines room?
Did the voice fit the mood?

tags.label: Imagery
tags.strength: The images in the poem came alive.
tags.toWork: Slow down on the key images so we can picture them.

tags.label: Pacing
tags.strength: Your pacing gave key moments room to land.
tags.toWork: Slow down at key moments so they have room to land.

tags.label: Voice
tags.strength: Your voice fit the mood of the piece.
tags.toWork: Match your voice more closely to the mood of each moment.

tags.label: Script use
tags.strength: You used the script with skill and control.
tags.toWork: Handle the script more smoothly so it does not distract.

tags.label: Intro
tags.strength: Your intro set up the piece well and named the title and author.
tags.toWork: Use the intro to set up the piece and name the title and author.

source: NSDA Middle School Unified Manual, 2026-27 season (Prose and Poetry run 7:00 in middle school). Summarized in our own words; no rule text copied.
